traceDiagram.title: Trainers GraphQL resolver flow diagram
traceDiagram.description: This diagram shows how `TrainersResolver` answers the `trainers` query, the `awardBadge` mutation, the `badgeAwarded` subscription and the `team` field. It also shows what happens when a request sends `awardBadge`, and how the badge reaches the stored trainer through `withBadge()`.

traceNodes.label: Answers the GraphQL operations on trainers
traceNodes.description: When the app starts, [`TrainersModule` lists this class in its `providers`](code:src/trainers/trainers.module.ts#L6). Nest then runs one of its methods for each GraphQL operation on a trainer.

children.label: Lists the trainers, or the trainers of one hometown
children.description: When a client sends the `trainers` query, Nest runs this method with the `hometown` argument of the query.

blockLabels.label: Calls this.trainersService.list to read every trainer
Returns the trainers of the hometown, or all when none is given

children.label: Awards a badge and publishes the trainer
children.description: When a client sends the `awardBadge` mutation, Nest runs this method with the `trainerId` and `badge` arguments of the mutation.

blockLabels.label: Calls this.trainersService.awardBadge to give the trainer the badge
Returns the trainer with the new badge

children.label: Sends each trainer that gets a badge
children.description: When a client opens the `badgeAwarded` subscription, Nest runs this method and sends each trainer that [`awardBadge()` publishes](code:src/trainers/trainers.resolver.ts#L22).

blockLabels.label: Returns an iterator over each published badge award

children.label: Resolves the team of a trainer
children.description: When a query asks for the `team` of a trainer, Nest runs this method with that trainer as its parent.

blockLabels.label: Returns the team of the trainer
Calls this.trainersService.teamOf to read the ordered team of the trainer

children.label: Ends a badge name with Badge
children.description: When a client sends the `awardBadge` mutation, [`awardBadge()` calls this method with the `badge` argument](code:src/trainers/trainers.resolver.ts#L21).

blockLabels.label: Returns the badge name ending in Badge

traceNodes.label: Keeps the trainers and their teams in memory
traceNodes.description: When the app starts, Nest makes this class and [hands it to the constructor of `TrainersResolver`](code:src/trainers/trainers.resolver.ts#L11).

children.label: Adds a badge to a stored trainer
children.description: When a client sends the `awardBadge` mutation, [`awardBadge()` of the resolver calls this method](code:src/trainers/trainers.resolver.ts#L21) with the trainer id and the full badge name.

blockLabels.label: Throws a NotFoundException when no trainer has the id
Calls withBadge to copy the trainer with the badge
Returns the trainer with the badge

children.label: Returns the team of a trainer
children.description: When a query asks for the `team` of a trainer, [`team()` of the resolver calls this method](code:src/trainers/trainers.resolver.ts#L33) with the id of the trainer.

blockLabels.label: Returns the team ordered by level
Calls orderTeam to order the team from the highest level down

traceNodes.label: Orders a team from the highest level down
traceNodes.description: When a query asks for the `team` of a trainer, `team()` calls `teamOf()`, and [`teamOf()` calls this function](code:src/trainers/trainers.service.ts#L31) with the stored team.

blockLabels.label: Returns a copy of the team from the highest level down

traceNodes.label: Copies a trainer with one more badge
traceNodes.description: When a client sends the `awardBadge` mutation, the resolver calls `awardBadge()` of the service, and [that method calls this function](code:src/trainers/trainers.service.ts#L25) with the stored trainer.

blockLabels.label: Returns the trainer as it is when it has the badge already
Returns a copy of the trainer with the badge added
